translations.web: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh.
translations.bsb: “For My thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways My ways,” declares the LORD.
translations.kjv: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the LORD.
